basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Senior Backend Engineer | Distributed & Event-Driven Systems | Search & Discovery
basics.summary: Senior backend engineer with 13+ years building distributed, event-driven systems for 10M+ users. Led a 3-team Search Platform revamp at Beekeeper (indexing and ranking redesign, measurable engagement lift), architected the Employee Referral System behind $1.5M+ in revenue at 99.99% SLA, and ran global on-call across Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io. Now Lead AI Engineer at LumApps building event-driven agent workflows on GCP Pub/Sub. Deep on TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Elastic Search, Kafka, AWS, and incident triage in complex production codebases.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Built event-driven backend for AI Brain: temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j, event ingest over GCP Pub/Sub from 5+ upstream systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, transcripts, product usage) with typed per-source contracts, freshness layer for stale-data detection, and per-agent query and write-back APIs.

Shipped production Python + TypeScript services (FastAPI, LangGraph, Google ADK) on GCP with LangSmith tracing, cost-per-request telemetry, evals, and on-call. Same shape as high-throughput backend + observability, applied to LLM traffic.
Report directly to C-level on outcomes. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, $1M forecast in quarterly revenue for the outbound product built on this platform.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Led Search Platform revamp across 3 teams: redesigned indexing and ranking pipelines on Elastic Search to surface what users mean, not just what they typed. Measurable engagement lift. Same shape as feed and discovery work.

Architected Employee Referral System end to end (Java, Vue, PostgreSQL, Elastic Search on Kubernetes). Became the platform's top revenue channel: $1.5M+ revenue, $500K ARR. Designed for 99.99% SLA at high traffic, integrated with third-party job boards over event-driven scraping.

Designed a distributed templating engine (Java, Kafka event streaming) that cut customer setup time 90%. Powers 15% of all assets for 10M+ users. Projection cache + event-driven invalidation for sub-100ms preview.

Ran observability and global on-call (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io) for high-traffic production. Diagnosed and triaged incidents across service, DB, and infra layers; enforced comprehensive unit, integration and E2E test coverage on critical flows.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Founding engineer for an EPFL spin-off. Shipped the full autonomous drone delivery platform (Vue/Java/PostgreSQL) that powered 500+ real-world deliveries. Built the backend, real-time flight control APIs, and logistics optimization from scratch.
Built AWS infrastructure (EC2, S3, Terraform IaC) and CI/CD pipeline from scratch. Enterprise-grade reliability that enabled a Unilever partnership and a CES showcase.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Senior Backend Engineer at X-Team (Europe remote), placing engineers with brands like Riot Games, Fox, Coinbase, Epic. Product squad building high-throughput, low-latency discovery systems (feed delivery, recommendation pipelines, event-driven data flows). Investigate system behavior, resolve performance bottlenecks, modernize a large production codebase. Must have: 5+ years distributed backend systems, Node.js + TypeScript primary, GraphQL/REST, NoSQL (DynamoDB), event-driven stream processing (Kinesis, EventBridge), AWS (ECS, DynamoDB, PostgreSQL), containerized deployments, comprehensive testing (unit/integration/E2E). Nice: recommendation/feed systems, Terraform IaC, React Native awareness, NestJS/Apollo GraphQL/Sentry/Snowflake/vector DBs.
_jobApplication.notes: Primary backend language is Java (Beekeeper) + Python (LumApps), not Node.js. TypeScript is real from frontend + LumApps agent tooling. Emphasized event-driven architecture (Kafka + Pub/Sub), Search revamp = feed/discovery analog, PostgreSQL, AWS, and incident triage / on-call. Node.js gap will show up in a technical screen; consider whether to apply.
